countries.reasoning: Based on ICIS Chemical Business and UNEP data for 2022-2023, China is reported to produce a significant portion of global nitric acid production.
The United States has several large-scale facilities and is one of the largest producers after China based on industry reports from IHS Markit for the same period.
India's large chemical industry provides a substantial share of global nitric acid production as per data from the DRI (Department of Pharmaceuticals)
Germany is known for its advanced chemical industry and contributes significantly to global production based on reports by the German Chemical Association.
Japan's chemical sector plays a critical role in the global nitric acid market according to reports from Japan Institute of Plant Managers (JIPM).
